x-m-el-job-02.title: Ukusho Isivinini Esifanayo Ngamayunithi Amabili
x-m-el-job-02.goal: Usebenzisa ukuguqula phakathi kwesivinini ngomzuzu (m) nesivinini ngehora (km), zithole wena imibandela lapho kokubili amanani eyizinombolo zemvelo, bese uchaza ukuthi kungani.
x-m-el-job-02.material: Abantu ababili eklabhini yokugijima bachaze isivinini esifanayo ngamayunithi ahlukile. Omunye wathi 'u-x m ngomzuzu' (ibanga elihanjwe ngomzuzu o-1), futhi omunye wathi 'u-y km ngehora' (ibanga elihanjwe ngehora eli-1). Befuna ukusho izinombolo njengezinombolo zemvelo kuphela, ngaphandle kwamadesimali noma izingxenyana.
x-m-el-job-02.prereq.0: 1 km = 1000 m, ihora eli-1 = imizuzu engu-60
x-m-el-job-02.prereq.1: Isivinini sivezwa njengebanga elihanjwe ngesikhathi esifanayo (izinga lesikole esiphakeme)
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.prompt: Isivinini somuntu ogijima u-6 km ngehora singamamitha amangaki ngomzuzu cishe? Qala ulinganisele usayizi.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.hint.0: Qala uguqule ibanga elihanjwe ehoreni eli-1 libe yi-m.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlukanisa leli banga ngemizuzu engu-60 ukuze ulinganisele ibanga elihanjwe ngomzuzu o-1.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.r.a: Hlola ukuthi ithatha cishe imizuzu engu-10 ukuya ku-1 km yini. Hlola indlela oguqula ngayo amayunithi.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.r.c: U-1000 m ngomzuzu uhambisana no-60 km ngehora. Hlola isilinganiso somzuzu o-1 nehora eli-1.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s1.explain: U-6 km ngehora ungu-6000 m ehoreni eli-1, futhi ihora eli-1 limizuzu engu-60, ngakho ungu-100 m cishe ngomzuzu o-1.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amapheya ahlukene angu-3 ezinombolo zemvelo, isivinini ngomzuzu x (m) nesivinini ngehora y (km), ezenza isivinini esifanayo. Isivinini ngehora siyisuka ku-6 kuya ku-20 kufakiwe (ibanga umuntu angagijima kulo).
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.0: Veza ngama-km ibanga elihanjwe ehoreni eli-1 ku-x m ngomzuzu.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.1: Misa isivinini esisodwa ngehora bese uhlola ukuthi isivinini ngomzuzu siyinombolo yemvelo yini.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.hint.2: Uma ezinye izivinini ngehora zingenzi izinombolo zemvelo, funa lokho lezo zivinini ezinakho ngokufanayo.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c1: U-x no-y kumele babe yizinombolo zemvelo.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c2: U-x m ngomzuzu no-y km ngehora akusona isivinini esifanayo. Qhathanisa ibanga elihanjwe ehoreni eli-1 eyunithini efanayo.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Isivinini ngehora kumele sibe kusukela ku-6 kuya ku-20 kufakiwe.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.explain: U-100 m ngomzuzu ungu-6000 m ehoreni eli-1, ngakho ungu-6 km ngehora. Njalo uma isivinini ngomzuzu sikhula ngo-50 m, isivinini ngehora sikhula ngo-3 km. Ngakho 100/6, 150/9, 200/12, 250/15, 300/18 yimapheya angenzeka.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Chaza ukuthi kungani u-7 km noma u-8 km ngehora engasebenzi, kodwa u-6, 9 no-12 km basebenza.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Uma uguqula u-y km ngehora ube yisivinini ngomzuzu, kuba yingxenyana. Bheka ukuthi u-y kumele abe njani ukuze isihlukanisi sihlukane ngokulinganayo.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Bala isivinini ngomzuzu sika-7 no-8 ngqo, bese uthola ukuthi kungani sibe yidesimali.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: Isibonelo: Uma uguqula isivinini ngehora sibe yisivinini ngomzuzu, ...
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingabe uhlole ukuthi amapheya owenzile alandela umthetho ofanayo?
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingabe uchaze isizathu somthetho ngokubuza 'kungani u-3 (noma u-50) ngokuqondile?'
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.model.0: U-y km ngehora kusivinini ngomzuzu ungu-1000×y÷60 = 50y/3 m. Ukuze kube yinombolo yemvelo, u-y kumele abe okuphindwe ngo-3, ngakho u-6, 9, 12 basebenza futhi u-7, 8 abasebenzi.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.model.1: U-x m ngomzuzu ungu-60x m = 0.06x km ehoreni eli-1. Ukuze kokubili kube yizinombolo eziphelele, u-x kumele abe okuphindwe ngo-50, futhi bese isivinini ngehora siyakhula ngo-3 njalo.
x-m-el-job-02.s.s2.because.model.2: Ukuguqula isivinini u-y ngehora saba ngomzuzu kunika u-50y/3, ngakho u-y kumele ahlukaniswe ngo-3 ukuze abe yinombolo yemvelo. U-6, 9, no-12 basebenza, futhi u-7 no-8 abasebenzi.

x-m-el-job-10.goal: Funda ukuthi idatha yenyanga eyodwa noma ezimbili ayanele ukukhetha uhlelo, nokuthi uhlelo olungcono lushintsha uma ukusetshenziswa kushintsha, bese uthola umkhawulo.

Ukusetshenziswa kubalwa nge-GB ephelele kuphela.

x-m-el-job-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Ukusetshenziswa okulindelekile kwezinyanga ezi-4 ezizayo ngu-8 GB, 13 GB, 14 GB no-15 GB.

x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.prompt: Yenza amanani ama-2 ahlukile okusetshenziswa kwenyanga u-x GB lapho Uhlelo B lushibhile kuno-Uhlelo A. (u-x yinombolo ephelele kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-40)

x-m-el-job-10.s.s2.explain: Imali ka-A ngu-30,000 + 5,000×(x−10). Idlula u-42,000원 uma x ingu-13 noma ngaphezulu. Ku-x=12 ingu-40,000원 futhi u-A usashibhile, futhi ku-13 ingu-45,000원 futhi u-B uba shibhile.

x-m-el-job-05.goal: Yenza ukulandelana kwezethulo okuhlangabezana nazo zonke izimo, bese uchaza ukuthi ubale kanjani inani eliphelele lokulandelana okungenzeka ngaphandle kokuphutha lutho.

① U-A akakwazi ukuba owokuqala ngenxa yokumiswa kwempahla.
② U-D akakwazi ukuba owokugcina ngenxa yesinye isibopho.
③ Ividiyo ka-B isebenza njengengemuva lokwenza kuka-C, ngakho u-B kufanele enze ngaphambi kuka-C.
Inombolo yokulandelana 1 iyokuqala futhi u-4 ngowokugcina.
